triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:spec` (the `.custom` arrangement, `deriveRelatedLists`) · `needs-user-decision`; rationale: area:ux (record page tabs) · Feature · after PR #36517, an environment administrator can hide a relationship tab of an installed object but not its three built-in tabs (attachments, approvals, activity stream): an unlisted built-in still shows, `hidden` is refused on a built-in entry, and the environment cannot patch the object's own `enable` keys. The product question for the maintainer: accept `{ list: sys_attachment | sys_approval_request | sys_activity, hidden: true }` in the `.custom` arrangement only, as a second switch beside the object's `enable` keys, or not. It is additive and does not block #36517 (l2-review#4 record 7084262686) → p2 · size S. Topic #36359 / card #36498. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7084285649).

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage note: #36627 (filed 04:25Z by seat 2) asks the same question for every object (should admins be able to hide the built-in Attachments, Approvals and Activity tabs?). One maintainer answer settles both cards.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Closed with the ruling on #36627 (2026-11-23T12:00Z). The maintainer chose option A′ at 2026-11-23T11:57Z (「36627 选 A′」): built-in record tabs get no hide switch, in an environment arrangement or anywhere else. On an installed object, the way to remove Attachments is to switch off its files capability. The Activity stream will drop itself when all its sources are off, carried by #36693. Not planned as asked.
